title: Blindfolded
author: Aneek Chatterjee
text:
I`m blindfolded now.
And happy.

Deceit, injustice, violence,
murder and potholes do not
appear in my sight and
foresight anymore.

But they keep crawling
silently to my head, which remains heavy
with the weight of a stupendous rock,
all the time.

In some deep and dark nights,
when I untie the long cloth,
fire from a burning house
engulfs me and shouts merrily:
`We`ve devastated all dissents`.

Quickly I fasten the strip on my eyes
and return happy.

with the weight of a stupendous rock,

when I untie the long cloth,
Quickly I fasten the strip on my eyes
